Hot kitchen · À la carte

Kasundi roast chicken

Mustard-glazed chicken, roasted carrots, charred greens, and pan jus.

View dish notes
My role
Prepared the glaze and garnishes, roasted the chicken under supervision, and finished the plate at the pass.
Technique
Used pan drippings for the jus and plated the greens last so they held their texture.

A chilled coconut set with mango and sesame brittle.

View dish notes
My role

Banquet · Menu development

A vegetarian banquet main

View menu notes
My role
Tested a tasting portion, drafted the portion guide, and assisted with a mock banquet pickup.
Service decision

Kitchen operations · Mise en place

Ready for service

Training & service

Kitchen placement

Hotel training placement · 2025 · Hot kitchen and banquet rotations

  • Prepared garnishes and sides for à la carte service under the station chef.
  • Supported banquet batch prep, portioning, and plating checks at the pass.

Culinary training

Diploma in Culinary Arts · 2024–2025

  • Kitchen fundamentals, sauces, basic pastry, menu planning, and portion costing.
  • Food safety coursework covering allergen communication, safe storage, and temperature logs.
Practice scenario · Allergen request at the pass

When a ticket flagged a sesame allergy, I paused the plate, alerted the station chef, checked the recipe and garnish together, and followed the kitchen’s procedure before service resumed.
